description:
Random code lock codes that avoid the ones raiders try first. The door code generator (https://rust.wiki/calculators/door-code): random four-digit codes from the server's
cryptographic random source, re-drawn until they match none of the guessable patterns the page checks (the 10
most common codes, one digit four times, runs like 1234, repeated pairs, mirrors, years, dates, two-digit codes),
each with a different guest code. Codes are made fresh per request and never stored (the response is marked
no-store); for a code that never leaves your device, use the page, which makes them in your browser. Give the user the code and guest code; they set them on the lock in game.

count.description: How many code pairs to make.
